# SPEC.md

> SPEC.md is an open, Markdown-based format for describing a system's design and required behavior independently of any particular implementation, so a person or LLM can create a conforming implementation without the original codebase.

## Core

- [SPEC.md Core 0.4.3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPECmd-app/SPEC.md/main/docs/standard/0.4.3.md): The current minimal, self-contained authoring standard. Start here.
- [SPEC.md Optional 0.4.3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPECmd-app/SPEC.md/main/docs/standard/0.4.3-optional.md): Optional extensions, richer authoring patterns, and companion artifacts. Use only what a project actually needs.

## Example

- [Judo Club Website SPEC.md (0.4.2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPECmd-app/SPEC.md/main/examples/judo-club-specmd-0.4.2.md): A complete worked example showing SPEC.md Core applied to a small multilingual website.

## Agent integrations

- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPECmd-app/SPEC.md/main/integrations/claude-code/CLAUDE.md): Drop-in living-spec policy for Claude Code.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SPECmd-app/SPEC.md/main/integrations/codex/AGENTS.md): Drop-in living-spec policy for Codex.

## Tooling

- [specmd-cli](https://github.com/SPECmd-app/specmd-cli): Companion CLI and MCP server (`specmd`, `specmd-mcp`) for authoring, validating, inspecting, rendering, and tracing SPEC.md documents. An intentionally partial implementation — see its README for exactly what is and isn't implemented.
